opportunities.title: Industrial Control Panel Schematics
opportunities.description: I have an industrial machine project that now needs clear, build-ready documentation. I’m looking for precise electrical schematics together with a detailed 2-D control-panel layout that an electrician can follow without second-guessing anything. Scope – The schematics must cover the entire production-line control system, showing every motor, sensor, safety device, PLC, relay, contactor, power supply, push button, indicator light, and the touch-screen HMI. – Wire numbers, terminal references, and device tags should match across the schematic pages and the physical panel drawing. – Component spacing, DIN-rail positions, cable ducts, and panel cut-outs should be shown to scale so the shop can drill, punch, and wire directly from your drawing. Preferred workflow If you typically use AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or a similar package, that will slot in perfectly with the rest of our documentation. I can supply a bill of materials and the machine I/O list once we start; you’ll return native CAD files plus PDFs for the shop floor. Deliverables for sign-off • Complete multi-page schematic (PDF + editable CAD) • 2-D control-panel layout with dimensions (PDF + editable CAD) I will walk through the draft with you online, then give a single consolidated markup before final release. If everything is clear enough for the panel builder to wire without calling back, we’re done.

opportunities.title: Diseño App Nutricionista Móvil
opportunities.description: Necesito un diseño de aplicación pensado específicamente para nutricionistas que les permita crear y enviar planes de alimentación personalizados a cada paciente. Lo esencial es contar con pantallas intuitivas donde el profesional pueda armar menús y recetas adaptadas, asignarlas al paciente y compartirlas de forma clara y atractiva. opportunities.title: Create STL From Photo
opportunities.description: I have one clear reference image and I’d like it transformed into a clean, watertight STL that I can send straight to my 3-D printer for a decorative display piece. Because the photo shows only one angle, you will need solid modeling skills to extrapolate the unseen sides while keeping proportions natural and print-friendly. What I will supply • The single photo (JPEG/PNG) and any notes on overall size. • Prompt feedback on your first pass so you’re not guessing twice. What I need back 1. A manifold, error-free STL ready for FDM printing. 2. The model scaled to the dimensions we agree on (units in millimetres). 3. Optional: the native file (Blender, ZBrush, Fusion 360—whichever you prefer) in case I’d like tweaks later. Acceptance criteria • No non-manifold edges, flipped normals, or mesh holes—runs through standard slicer checks without repairs. • Details from the photo captured faithfully, with reasonable artistic interpretation for hidden surfaces. • Overhangs minimised to avoid excessive supports. If you enjoy creative modelling from limited references and can deliver quickly, let’s talk and get this piece on the build plate.

opportunities.title: Engaging Kannada Post Copy
opportunities.description: I’m planning to turn the line “ವಿಶ್ವಸದಲ್ಲೆ ವಿಷ ಎರುತ್ತೆ ಮಗ, ಯಾರುನ್ನು ಸುಲಾಭವಾಗಿ ನಂಬಬೇಡ” into a compelling social-media post and I need help crafting the copy. My clear goal is to spark strong reactions and encourage maximum shares across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and other platforms frequented by all Kannada speakers. Here’s what I’m looking for: • A short, catchy primary caption in Kannada that instantly grabs attention. • 2–3 alternative caption variations so I can A/B test which one earns the most reactions and re-shares. • A brief supporting line or two (optional) that I can place in the post body if longer text is needed. Tone & style: conversational yet thought-provoking, true to the cautionary message in the original quote. It must feel relatable to everyday Kannada readers, stir their curiosity, and invite them to comment or tag friends. Deliverables are final text files (plain TXT or Google Doc) ready to copy-paste into my social channels. If you regularly craft high-engagement Kannada content and understand what gets people talking online, I’d love to see what you can deliver.

opportunities.title: Refine, Secure & Launch Express Kitchen App
opportunities.description: Project Description: Complete, Secure, and Launch My Express Kitchen Web Application I have an existing cloud-kitchen food ordering web application, Express Kitchen, built using React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, Firebase/Firestore, and Google Cloud. The application is already developed, but several functionalities require debugging, security improvements, end-to-end testing, and production deployment. Website: https://Express-Kitchen.ai.studio Please check end to end functionality with Sample users Aarav Mehta 9876500001 Password@123 Pooja Patil 9876500002 Password@123 And backend Admin Page https://Express-Kitchen.ai.studio/Admin Admin AdminPassword@123 I am looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer who can take ownership of the existing application, fix the outstanding issues, preserve all working features, and make the website fully functional, secure, and production-ready. 1. Complete Application Audit and Bug Fixes - Review the existing source code and application architecture. - Identify and resolve broken functionality, runtime errors, API failures, and database issues. - Restore previously working features without unnecessary UI redesign or rebuilding the application from scratch. - Verify that the frontend, backend, APIs, and database work together correctly. 2. Customer Ordering and Admin Functionality - Ensure customers can browse menus, select food items, customize orders, apply coupons, and complete checkout. - Verify cart management, pricing calculations, taxes, delivery charges, discounts, and order totals. - Ensure orders are saved correctly and remain available after page refreshes, server restarts, and deployments. - Verify that administrators can manage menu items, prices, coupons, orders, customers, inventory, and order statuses. - Ensure all existing business functions work as expected. 3. Secure Login, OTP, and Password Reset - Fix customer and administrator login, logout, session management, and authentication. - Integrate and validate MSG91 OTP verification for the existing customer login flow. - Fix the administrator forgot-password workflow using WhatsApp OTP through the configured MSG91 messaging service, including secure password reset and confirmation. - Resolve infinite loading screens, failed OTP delivery, incorrect verification, and password reset errors. - Implement appropriate OTP expiration, retry limits, rate limiting, and secure password storage. 4. Razorpay Payment Integration - Verify the complete payment lifecycle, including order creation, payment success, payment failure, cancellation, and refunds where supported. - Implement secure server-side payment verification and Razorpay webhook signature validation. - Prevent duplicate orders, duplicate payment processing, and fraudulent payment-success responses. - Ensure order and payment statuses remain consistent, including when callbacks are delayed or the customer closes the browser. 5. Security and Data Protection - Identify and fix critical vulnerabilities in authentication, authorization, APIs, and database access. - Secure administrator routes and ensure customers cannot access other customers' personal information or orders. - Configure appropriate Firestore security rules and backend access controls. - Remove authentication bypasses, test-mode payment fallbacks, exposed secrets, and insecure production configurations. - Protect customer information, passwords, OTPs, payment data, and administrative records. - Implement input validation, rate limiting, secure sessions, and appropriate security headers. 6. Firebase and Google Cloud Production Deployment - Review the current Firebase and Google Cloud configuration and select the appropriate production hosting architecture. - Ensure the application uses reliable persistent storage rather than local file-based storage that may fail in a multi-instance cloud environment. - Configure production environment variables, secrets, domain settings, HTTPS, and CORS correctly. - Verify database backups, recovery procedures, application health checks, error logging, and monitoring. - Deploy the application without unnecessary downtime and provide a rollback plan if issues occur. 7. MSG91 and Customer Notifications - Verify the configured OTP and WhatsApp messaging integrations. - Ensure relevant customer notifications are triggered at the correct stages of the order lifecycle, where these features already exist. - Handle API failures, retries, duplicate notifications, and delivery errors appropriately. - Ensure messaging credentials and customer information are protected. 8. Complete End-to-End Testing Perform end-to-end testing of all existing functionality, including: - Customer registration, login, OTP verification, and password reset. - Menu browsing, cart management, coupons, checkout, and order placement. - Successful, failed, and cancelled payments. - Duplicate payment callbacks and order consistency. - Administrator login and all existing administrative functions. - Order updates, notifications, and database persistence. - Unauthorized access, customer-data isolation, and security controls. - Mobile responsiveness and basic performance checks. - Production deployment, application health, error handling, and recovery procedures. Provide a test report listing the test scenarios, results, outstanding issues, and any limitations. 9. Performance, Handover, and Support - Optimize existing code and API performance where necessary. - Fix major console errors, backend errors, and avoidable loading delays. - Maintain the existing design and business workflows unless a change is necessary to fix a defect. - Provide source-code updates, deployment instructions, configuration documentation, and a list of completed fixes. - Provide post-launch support to resolve defects related to the agreed scope. Expected Deliverables The project will be considered complete when the existing application has been audited, the agreed critical defects have been fixed, security controls have been validated, the existing functionality has passed regression testing, and the application is successfully deployed and verified in production. The developer must not simply make the website accessible. The objective is to make it secure, reliable, fully functional, and ready to accept real customer orders and payments. Project Budget and Timeline - Budget: ₹25,000–₹40,000, depending on the audit findings and agreed scope. - Target timeline: 3–7 days, subject to the initial audit and complexity of the fixes. - Engagement: Fixed-price project with milestone-based payments. - Important: This is an existing application that needs completion and remediation, not a complete redesign or rebuild. Please apply only if you have hands-on experience debugging, securing, testing, and deploying production web applications using React, Node.js, Firebase, and Google Cloud. In your proposal, explain your approach, earliest availability, estimated timeline, relevant experience, and fixed-price quotation.

opportunities.title: Rediseño 2D Bowser Diésel
opportunities.description: Cuento con varias fotos recientes del bowser diésel y las medidas principales de su estructura. Necesito transformar esa información en un plano 2D completamente nuevo donde la distribución general y las dimensiones queden claras y bien proporcionadas. El dibujo resultante se presentará a un cliente para aprobación, por lo que debe verse limpio, profesional y fácil de leer. Aun así, lo esencial es que la planta y los alzados muestren con exactitud el tamaño del tanque, la posición de los ejes, guardabarros, escalones y demás elementos volumétricos: los detalles finos de tuberías o rótulos pueden mantenerse como referencia, pero el foco está en lograr un layout coherente y a escala. Entrego de inicio: • Carpeta con las fotografías. • Tabla con las medidas clave (largo total, ancho, alto del tanque, diámetro de ruedas, etc.). Espero de tu parte el archivo fuente (DWG o compatible) y un PDF listo para imprimir en formato ISO A1. Toda la acotación debe emplear unidades métricas y estilo estándar, y agradeceré que incluyas un pequeño cuadro resumen con la capacidad estimada del tanque calculada a partir de las nuevas dimensiones. Si tienes experiencia recalculando volúmenes y ajustando layouts de equipos móviles, este encargo te quedará cómodo. Podemos coordinar una breve videollamada para revisar dudas antes de que arranques.

opportunities.title: Premium Brand Video Motion Designer
opportunities.description: We need a Motion Graphics Designer / Video Editor for an upcoming brand video project. Please find the project details and hiring requirement below. Project: 45-Second Brand Introduction Video Team: Video / Creative Team Experience: Preferably 2+ years of relevant experience Project Deadline: Monday, 26 October 2026 As an initial approach, we can consider hiring a freelancer on an hourly basis for this video project. Depending on their performance, quality of work and overall suitability, we can explore offering them a permanent role. Role Overview We are looking for a skilled Motion Graphics Designer / Video Editor to create a premium, contemporary 45-second brand introduction video based on an existing PowerPoint presentation. The video should communicate the brand's identity, expertise, human approach and use of AI through polished animation, visual storytelling and seamless transitions. The output should feel like a professional brand film rather than an animated PowerPoint presentation. Key Responsibilities Create a high-quality 45-second brand video in 16:9 widescreen format. Develop custom 2D motion graphics, typography animation, logo reveals and smooth transitions. Animate brand elements, including ribbon/swirl graphics, statistics, icons and process diagrams. Bring existing photography and product interface visuals to life using subtle zooms, pans, layered movement and compositing. Follow the supplied brand guidelines, including colours, typography, logo usage and visual direction. Work with existing PowerPoint content while preserving approved wording and messaging. Integrate suitable background music and subtle sound effects. Edit, render and export the final video in a presentation-ready format. Incorporate feedback and deliver revisions within the agreed timeline. Required Technical Skills Strong proficiency in Adobe After Effects for motion graphics and animation, or DaVinci Resolve with Fusion for equivalent motion design and compositing work. Good video editing skills using DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Experience with keyframe animation, masking, motion paths, typography animation, compositing and transitions. Understanding of visual storytelling, timing, pacing and brand consistency. Ability to work with existing design assets and maintain accurate product visuals. A strong portfolio demonstrating professionally produced brand films, explainer videos or corporate motion graphics. Good-to-Have Skills Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop for preparing visual assets. Experience animating SaaS product interfaces and software demonstrations. Sound design and audio synchronisation. Experience creating premium corporate or technology brand videos. Deliverables One polished brand introduction video, no longer than 45 seconds. 16:9 widescreen format. Final video with music and sound effects, without voiceover. Revisions based on client feedback. Editable project/source files, if required.

opportunities.title: YouTube Video Producer With N8N Automation System Needed
opportunities.description: Hi, We’re looking for a long-term partner with a pre-built N8N youtube automation system, and experience running it, to support our team. This is not a one-time collaboration, but a partnership where we’ll promote the service and forward the orders to the partner(s) we select. We produce custom animations and explainer videos and we want to start offering complete YouTube automation packages to our clients. Ideally, you already have a working N8N YouTube automation system and can operate it for us at low reseller prices. If you’re interested, please start your bid with “N8N” and answer these questions: 1. Do you already have a working, pre-built n8n YouTube automation system? If so, tell us more about your system. 2. Can you operate the system for us at the following prices? • Channel setup – $10: Channel branding, logo, banner, intro, SEO and channel keywords. • 10 long videos + 10 Shorts – $50: Ideas, scripts, AI voice-over, visuals, editing, thumbnails, uploading and SEO. • 15 long videos + 15 Shorts – $75: Same complete service as above. 4. Can your system handle the entire process, including branding, scripts, voice-over, visuals, subtitles, thumbnails, SEO and YouTube uploads? 5. Please share real examples of videos produced by your existing system. If it supports different video styles, please provide one example of each style. We prefer working with someone who already has an existing, proven system and experience running it for clients, but we're also open to working with someone who wants to develop and run the system for us.

opportunities.title: Frases Motivacionales Italianas Breves
opportunities.description: Necesito una colección de frases motivacionales escritas en italiano, pensadas para personas con baja autoestima. Las frases deben tener un tono profundo y reflexivo: quiero que inviten a la introspección, transmitan calma y, al mismo tiempo, siembren la certeza de que el cambio interior es posible. Uso principal Las publicaré sobre imágenes en redes sociales, por lo que cada frase debe ser lo bastante corta para encajar sin saturar la composición gráfica. Piensa en mensajes que impacten de un vistazo y dejen huella al releerse. Alcance y entregables • 40-50 frases originales, cada una de 8-12 palabras como máximo. • Formato: hoja de cálculo o documento con una frase por fila. • Una segunda columna con una breve explicación opcional (máx. 15 palabras) que me ayude a escoger la imagen adecuada; no aparecerá en la publicación final. Criterios de aceptación 1. Italiano natural, libre de errores gramaticales o giros forzados. 2. Tono siempre profundo y reflexivo, evitando clichés motivacionales demasiado obvios. 3. Sin plagio: todo debe ser contenido original; comprobaré frases en buscadores antes de aprobar. Si necesitas más contexto sobre la audiencia o ejemplos de estética visual, dímelo y los facilito de inmediato.

opportunities.title: Full-Colour 3D Test Print
opportunities.description: I already have the printable files ready and now need a single full-colour prototype shipped within the UK as a trial run. The model is intended purely as a display or collection piece, and it carries a mix of fine and larger details, so I want it to look sharp on a shelf rather than withstand heavy handling. Because I am undecided between a sandstone-style finish and a smoother full-colour plastic, I would really value your advice on which material and print process will best capture my file’s detail while giving the richest colours. Once I see the first piece, I plan to commission several more, so your guidance now will set the standard for an ongoing series. Please quote tiered prices for at least three practical sizes (for example, small, medium, large) so I can judge scale against budget before we commit. If there are any preparation tweaks I should make to the file for either material, let me know—that way the test print becomes our reference for all future orders. Deliverables • One high-quality, full-colour printed model in the material you recommend • A brief note explaining why that material and finish were chosen and how future prints can be optimised • Clear price breakdowns for the additional size options, including estimated turnaround and UK shipping time I look forward to seeing how you can bring this piece to life.

opportunities.title: Cinematic GasFuse Safety Advertisement -- 2
opportunities.description: # Project Title: Professional Cinematic Video Advertisement for GasFuse LPG Safety Device | BFL Enterprises We are looking for an experienced and creative **video production expert, 3D animator or advertising agency** to create a premium, cinematic and emotionally engaging product advertisement for our **GasFuse LPG Safety Device**, a product of **BFL Enterprises (Building Future Living)**. The advertisement will be used for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, our company website and digital marketing campaigns across India. ## About Our Company **Company:** BFL Enterprises **Tagline:** Building Future Living **Website:** www.bflenterprises.com **Product:** GasFuse LPG Safety Device **Product Website:** https://gassafetydevice.co/ GasFuse was previously marketed under Jai Bharat Enterprises and is now being introduced under the BFL Enterprises brand. Our objective is to establish GasFuse as a recognizable LPG safety product in the Indian market while building trust in BFL Enterprises. ## About GasFuse GasFuse is an LPG gas safety device designed to provide an additional layer of protection against gas-related hazards in households and other compatible LPG installations. The product has undergone testing by **ARAI (Automotive Research Association of India)**. ### Product Features and Selling Points The advertisement should highlight the following: 1. **LPG Safety Protection:** Designed to help reduce risks associated with LPG gas leakage. 2. **Safety Mechanism:** Visually explain how GasFuse operates and responds to abnormal gas-flow conditions, based on the manufacturer's verified technical specifications. 3. **ARAI Tested:** Highlight that the device has been tested by ARAI. The exact wording and claims must match the supporting test documentation. 4. **Practical Application:** Demonstrate how the device fits into an LPG installation and its role in everyday kitchen safety. 5. **Indian Product:** Present GasFuse as a Made in India safety solution. 6. **Family Safety:** Emphasize the importance of taking precautions to protect loved ones from LPG-related accidents. 7. **Product Reliability:** Showcase the device's construction, engineering and practical safety benefits without making unsupported performance guarantees. We will provide product photographs, available technical specifications and supporting documentation to ensure the animation accurately represents its working mechanism. ## Video Concept and Storyline We want a **60-second premium cinematic advertisement** combining emotional storytelling, realistic 3D product animation, professional voice-over and impactful background music. **Scene 1: The Hidden Danger (0–10 seconds)** Show a happy Indian family at home, with a mother cooking in the kitchen and children nearby. Introduce the concern of unexpected LPG leakage using realistic visuals and subtle cinematic effects. Suggested voice-over: "Your home is where your most precious memories are made. But is your kitchen prepared for an unexpected gas leak?" **Scene 2: Introducing GasFuse (10–20 seconds)** Reveal the GasFuse device through high-quality 3D animation, dramatic lighting and premium product cinematography. Suggested voice-over: "Introducing GasFuse, an innovative LPG safety device designed to add an extra layer of protection to your home." **Scene 3: Product Features and Working Mechanism (20–40 seconds)** This is the most important section. Create detailed 3D animations showing: - The actual GasFuse device and its components. - Correct installation position within a compatible LPG setup. - Normal LPG gas flow. - The device's verified response to abnormal gas-flow conditions. - A clear visual comparison of normal operation and safety activation. - The product's safety-related benefits. - The ARAI testing credential. Animations must be technically accurate and based on the documentation we provide. **Scene 4: Emotional Family Connection (40–50 seconds)** Show a happy family enjoying their time together in a modern Indian home. Suggested voice-over: "Because safety isn't just about protecting your kitchen. opportunities.title: Universal VR Pool Cue Attachment Design -- 2
opportunities.description: I need a mechanical designer to create a back-of-cue attachment that lets me drop any major VR controller into place and start shooting virtual pool. It must grip the cue with an adjustable clamp that tightens cleanly around shafts from standard 12 mm up to break-cue diameters; no straps or sleeves—just one reliable, tool-less clamp. At the opposite end, I want another adjustable clamp with padded grips so I can swap between Meta Quest, PlayStation VR, and SteamVR controllers without worrying about scratches or slippage. The design should balance the overall cue length so the controller sits where a bumper normally would, preserving a realistic stroke. Please build the model in CAD (Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or similar) and deliver: • Fully detailed 3D files (STEP or IGES) • Exploded assembly and dimensioned drawings ready for prototyping • A brief bill of materials noting hardware, fasteners, and recommended padding I’ll test fit on multiple cues and controllers; final approval comes when I can clamp, tighten by hand, and play a full rack without movement. If tweaks are needed, a revision or two is part of the job.

opportunities.title: Single Airbnb Property Booking Site
opportunities.description: I need a clean, mobile-friendly website that showcases one Airbnb property and funnels guests straight to me, rather than back to the Airbnb platform. The core of the site is an engaging property page that features a full-screen photo gallery, a concise but persuasive description, and a clear breakdown of amenities so visitors immediately know what makes the stay special. A live availability calendar must sit beside the details, letting guests check their preferred dates and submit a booking request in a single step. Once a visitor selects dates, the form should capture their name, email, phone, and any special notes, then send the information to my inbox (and optionally store it in a simple database or Google Sheet). No on-site payments for now—just the request and my manual confirmation. Key deliverables • Responsive website (WordPress, Webflow, or similar) with custom domain connection • One main property page with photo gallery, description, and amenities section • Embedded availability calendar synced via iCal or a lightweight booking plugin • Booking-date form that validates input, then emails/stores requests • Basic SEO setup: clean URLs, meta tags, and image alt text • Handoff package with admin credentials and a quick video walk-through Acceptance criteria • Calendar accurately reflects my Airbnb iCal feed within 30 minutes of updates • Form submission reaches my email every time and logs to the agreed store • Site loads in under 3 seconds on mobile (PageSpeed Insights ≥ 80) • All text and images render correctly on desktop, tablet, and phone Once the site meets these points, I’ll consider the job complete and release the final milestone.

opportunities.title: Educational Animation Video Editor
opportunities.description: Project Brief: Educational Animation Video Creator We are seeking a dedicated video editor/animator FOR LONG TERM to transform provided educational lecture recordings and textbook material into concept-focused animated videos. • Reference Benchmark: • Visual Learning – Laws of Motion 3D Animation • https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KtHqOtCVAvc • https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jW2_H6-_72A NOTE- 2 D VIDEO ALSO OKAY NO ISSUE Project Phases & Compensation 1. Initial Test (2–4 Minutes) • Produce an initial 2 to 4 minute test cut to evaluate visual styling, text layout, and overall animation quality. • Work on the paid sample batch begins once this pilot receives formal approval. 2. Paid Sample Phase (4 Videos) • Deliverable: 4 complete sample videos (10 to 20 minutes each). • Payout: ₹1,500 per video (Total: ₹6,000 for 4 videos). • Expert Review & Revisions: Subject-matter experts and learners will review each video. You must accommodate a minimum of 2 to a maximum of 4 rounds of revisions per sample video based on expert feedback. 3. Bulk Project (200 to 400+ Videos) • After successful sign-off on the 4 samples, the project scales to ongoing production. • Volume: 200 to 400+ videos. • Duration: 10 to 20 minutes per video (depending on chapter scope). • Payout: Fixed rate of ₹700 per video. • Revisions: The same review process applies—each main video includes a minimum of 2 to a maximum of 4 revision rounds following the subject expert's review. • IF YOU ARE OKAY THEN ONLY PROCEED PLEASE Workflow & Expectations • Materials Provided: You will receive the raw video lecture content along with the corresponding textbook chapter for reference and context. • Visual Execution: Integrate clear 2D/3D animations, diagrams, labels, and motion graphics to visually unpack the concepts, aligning with the reference video style. • Audience Adaptability: While the curriculum covers Grade 12 topics, the animations must be clear and intuitive enough that learners in Grades 8, 9, 10, or 11 can readily grasp the fundamentals. • Quality & Reliability: Timely turnaround, responsiveness to revision feedback, and consistent production quality across all deliverables.

opportunities.title: Interior design
opportunities.description: I’m refreshing a public-facing office and need engaging 2D and 3D visuals that focus solely on furniture and décor. The shell, flooring, and fixed installations will stay as they are—your task is to transform the space through layout, furnishings, colours, lighting accents, and decorative elements. What I’m after: • A 2D furniture placement plan that clearly shows circulation paths and key measurements. • Photorealistic 3D renderings (at least three angles) illustrating the proposed look and feel. • A concise mood board with colour palette, material swatches, and style direction. • A basic shopping/spec list for the featured furniture, lighting, and accessories so I can source items or approved equivalents locally. Key points: • The area functions as an office that welcomes visitors, so the design must balance professionalism with an inviting atmosphere. • You’re free to suggest any style—modern, minimalist, biophilic, or a blend—so long as it remains practical for daily office use. • Deliver files in common formats: DWG/PDF for plans and JPEG/PNG (plus original 3D source, e.g., SketchUp, 3ds Max, or Revit) for renders. I’ll provide existing floor measurements, photos, and brand guidelines once we start. Let me know how many revisions you include and your typical turnaround time for each stage so we can schedule smoothly.

opportunities.title: Engaging Consulting Firm Pitch Deck
opportunities.description: I need a polished PowerPoint deck that positions my consulting firm as the logical choice for government officials and politicians. The goal is clear: by the final slide they should feel confident enough to hire us. You’ll be working from a concise outline of our services, past public-sector successes, and differentiators I will supply. I’m looking for roughly 8-10 slides that balance authority with visual appeal—think clean layouts, readable data visualisations, minimal text, and strong storytelling flow. Key elements to weave in: • A compelling introduction to our mission and values • Case studies highlighting measurable outcomes for government clients • Service overview with emphasis on policy insight and implementation support • Proof points such as certifications, testimonials, and cost-saving figures • A crystal-clear call-to-action that makes the next step—hiring us—obvious Please integrate modern design cues with fancy visuals suited to public-sector audiences (professional colour palette, accessible fonts, WCAG-friendly contrast). I work in PowerPoint 365, so all assets and animations must render flawlessly there. Any icons, images, or infographics should be either license-free or sourced from platforms that allow commercial use; cite sources where required. Deliverable: the editable .pptx file plus any linked assets. I’ll review one draft and one final revision before sign-off. If you have experience pitching to government stakeholders or crafting decks for consulting firms, let me know—that insight will be a big plus.

opportunities.title: AI Cinematic Story Videos
opportunities.description: I’m looking for someone who can turn fictional scripts into short, live-action–realistic videos using AI. The goal is to produce cinematic scenes that feel as if they were shot on set, complete with believable characters, natural lighting, and smooth camera work—yet created primarily through generative tools rather than a physical crew. Here’s what I need from you: • A full video for each story I provide (or that we co-develop) rendered in HD or higher, delivered as an MP4. • Any project files or prompts you use so I can archive and iterate later. I’m open to whichever combination of platforms you prefer—Runway, Sora-style diffusion models, ComfyUI, Stable Video, Unreal MetaHuman, DaVinci Resolve, or your own custom pipeline—so long as the final look lands squarely in “live-action movie realism.” Sound design and basic grading are a plus but not mandatory; we can discuss that once the visual quality is locked. To help me choose, please share: • A link to at least one AI-generated, live-action-looking clip you’ve produced. • A brief outline of your workflow from prompt or storyboard to final render. • Rough turnaround time per minute of finished footage. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right creator, and I’m happy to break the work into clear milestones—concept, draft render, and polished final—so we can keep feedback tight and momentum high. Looking forward to seeing how you’d bring these stories to life.

Al postular, menciona tu experiencia en roles similares y la disponibilidad horaria que podrías ofrecer.

opportunities.title: Asistente FAQ para WhatsApp
opportunities.description: Quiero poner en marcha un asistente virtual dentro de mi número de WhatsApp Business que se encargue exclusivamente de responder las preguntas frecuentes de mis clientes. El interés principal es que cualquier persona pueda consultar, en el mismo chat, qué productos tengo, su precio y si hay stock disponible en ese momento. Yo facilitaré un archivo actualizado con todo el catálogo: nombres, descripciones breves, precios y unidades disponibles. El bot tiene que leer esa fuente, interpretarla y contestar de forma clara cuando el usuario pregunte, por ejemplo, “¿Tienes el modelo X?” o “¿Cuánto cuesta el producto Y?”. Siempre debe basarse en la información que encuentre en el archivo y no inventar datos si algo no está listado. Además de entregar el bot funcionando dentro de WhatsApp (puede ser mediante la API oficial, Twilio, Meta Cloud o la solución que domines), necesito que me expliques cómo sustituir el archivo cada vez que renueve el inventario para que las respuestas sigan actualizadas. Una breve guía paso a paso es suficiente. Entrego: • Archivo CSV/Excel con el catálogo. Espero: • Chatbot activo en mi línea de WhatsApp Business. • Integración lista para refrescar datos con el nuevo archivo. • Instrucciones sencillas para hacer ese reemplazo. Si ya tienes experiencias previas montando bots con la API de WhatsApp o librerías como Python-WhatsApp, Node, Dialogflow, etc., cuéntamelo en tu propuesta y elige la que veas más ágil.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40782287, publicado hace 12 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.

Valoro experiencia previa en atención al cliente, argumentación comercial y manejo fluido de WhatsApp Business (etiquetas, respuestas rápidas, catálogos). Si conoces técnicas de copywriting o embudos de venta, menciónalo: sumarás puntos. Indícame tu disponibilidad horaria y el tiempo promedio de respuesta que puedes garantizar.

opportunities.title: Preparar artículo Wikipedia inglés
opportunities.description: Debes tener cuenta en Wikipedia inglés con artículos ya publicados. Cuento con un artículo redactado en inglés fuera de la plataforma y necesito corregir y darle formato para que cumpla los estándares de Wikipedia. El trabajo se centra en corregir y dar formato, con especial atención a la estructura, las secciones, las tablas y el infobox. El texto ya está completo; lo que requiero es convertirlo en wikitext listo para publicarse siguiendo el Manual of Style de la Wikipedia en inglés (MOS). Entrego el borrador en Word/Google Docs y espero recibir: • Versión en wikitexto con la jerarquía correcta de secciones, encabezados y enlaces internos. • Tablas y plantillas convertidas a sintaxis Wiki, bien alineadas y accesibles. • Infobox adecuado (con la plantilla pertinente) rellenado correctamente. • Notas sobre cualquier ajuste necesario para evitar problemas de neutralidad o verificabilidad. • Breve guía de pasos finales para subirlo al espacio principal, incluidos resúmenes de edición recomendados. Se valorará experiencia previa editando en enwiki, conocimiento de herramientas como VisualEditor, Wikicode y referencias a políticas clave (NPOV, Verifiability). Busco un resultado limpio, coherente y listo para revisión comunitaria sin tropiezos técnicos.

opportunities.title: Central IA para Gestión de Requerimientos
opportunities.description: Somos una empresa pequeña de seguridad privada que está iniciando y tenemos un WhatsApp Business utilizado por nuestra Central de Monitoreo. Buscamos un desarrollador que nos ayude a implementar una automatización sencilla y económica, utilizando IA/bots y WhatsApp Business, sin necesidad de desarrollar un sistema complejo. Lo que necesitamos 1. Reacciones automáticas en grupos Nuestro WhatsApp de Central pertenece a grupos donde los guardias realizan reportes. Queremos que automáticamente: • Seleccione aleatoriamente algunos reportes. • Reaccione con me gusta directamente al mensaje. • Aproximadamente 10 reacciones al día: 5 durante el día y 5 durante la noche. • Sin enviar mensajes adicionales. Importante: El desarrollador deberá confirmar si esto es técnicamente posible con la solución que propone. 2. Atención automática a clientes Cuando un cliente escriba directamente a nuestro WhatsApp, queremos una atención mediante IA que sea natural, profesional y breve. La IA deberá identificar principalmente: * Operativo: consultas y requerimientos normales que pueda atender la Central. Se registra y se informa al Jefe de Operaciones. * Importante: quejas, fallas, ausencias, incumplimientos o incidentes. Se registra y se informa al Jefe de Operaciones. * Crítico: robo, intrusión, agresión, incendio o emergencias. Se registra y se informa al Jefe de Operaciones. 3. Solicitudes fuera del alcance Si el cliente solicita algo que la Central no puede realizar, por ejemplo una supervisión presencial, reemplazo de guardia, envío de supervisor u otra actividad no contemplada, la IA deberá simplemente indicar: “Hemos recibido su requerimiento. Lo informaremos al Jefe de Operaciones para su gestión y atención. Se dará solución al requerimiento lo antes posible.” No deberá prometer acciones que GESAC no haya confirmado. 4. Atención natural Las respuestas no deben ser instantáneas. Queremos un pequeño tiempo de espera, aproximadamente 30 segundos o más, para que la conversación sea natural. También necesitamos poder tomar manualmente una conversación cuando sea necesario. Buscamos una solución económica Somos una empresa de seguridad pequeña y estamos iniciando, por lo que tenemos un presupuesto limitado. No buscamos desarrollar una plataforma grande ni un sistema complejo. Queremos comenzar con una solución sencilla, funcional y económica, utilizando herramientas/API existentes siempre que sea posible. El postulante deberá indicarnos: • Qué tecnología propone. • Si puede realizar las reacciones me gusta en grupos. • Costo del desarrollo. • Costos mensuales aproximados de WhatsApp/IA u otras herramientas. • Tiempo estimado. Se valorarán especialmente propuestas económicas, simples y fáciles de mantener.

Las tomas deben mostrar claramente el contenido que se proyecta, la estructura completa de la valla y su entorno inmediato para que se aprecie la escala y el contexto. Aceptación: las imágenes deben estar bien expuestas, libres de desenfoques, sin reflejos que oculten el contenido mostrado en la pantalla y con suficiente iluminación para uso comercial. Adjunta una propuesta detallada que incluya tu metodología, tiempos y cualquier recurso extra que consideres necesario para asegurar la cobertura completa dentro del plazo urgente indicado.

opportunities.title: Gestor de ventas por WhatsApp
opportunities.description: Manejo un negocio de productos físicos y la mayoría de mis clientes escriben por WhatsApp. Necesito a alguien que se convierta en mi “mano derecha” en el chat para que la conversación fluya y termine en una compra cerrada. Lo que requiero que hagas: • Contestar dudas sobre productos con información clara y amable. • Tomar pedidos y datos de envío con exactitud, usando la plantilla que compartiré. • Convencer al cliente para que compre aplicando técnicas de venta persuasivas pero respetuosas. Detalles operativos: – El horario es flexible, pero espero respuestas ágiles (idealmente en menos de 10 minutos cuando haya mensajes nuevos). – Te entregaré catálogo, precios, políticas y ejemplos de respuestas para que tengas todo a mano. – Registra cada conversación y venta en una hoja de cálculo de seguimiento; esto incluye nombre del cliente, producto, monto y dirección de envío. – Si surge alguna pregunta que no puedas resolver, me la escalas de inmediato. Busco una persona con ortografía impecable, buena conexión a internet y gusto por el trato al cliente. Si ya tienes experiencia cerrando ventas por WhatsApp, cuéntame resultados concretos; de lo contrario, muéstrame cómo abordarías una consulta típica. Quiero crear una relación a largo plazo que genere ingresos para ambos y ayude a mi familia a seguir creciendo con este negocio.

opportunities.title: Teleoperador de Seguros por Comisión
opportunities.description: Teleoperador/a de seguros con experiencia. Remoto, horario de España, solo comisión. Agencia de seguros en Toledo (España) busca una persona con experiencia demostrable en venta telefónica de seguros para llamar a nuestra cartera de clientes y vender cuatro ramos: hogar, decesos, vida y accidentes, y salud. Renovaciones, seguimiento de presupuestos y venta cruzada a clientes que ya nos conocen. Sin captación en frío a particulares. Condiciones: unas 3 horas al día en horario comercial de España (mañanas o tardes a convenir), colaboración mercantil por objetivos. Sin fijo: cobras el 50 % de la comisión que la aseguradora paga a la agencia por cada póliza nueva que consigas, durante el primer año de la póliza, al cobro del primer recibo. La agencia cobra el 15 % de la prima en hogar, decesos, vida y accidentes, y el 10 % en salud: tu parte es el 7,5 % y el 5 % de cada prima. Además, 100 EUR de bono por cada 5 pólizas del mismo ramo emitidas en el mismo mes. Prueba de 2 semanas y continuidad si funciona. opportunities.title: Buscamos teleoperadores con experiencia en ventas — Español neutro
opportunities.description: Buscamos profesionales con experiencia en ventas telefónicas para unirse a nuestra campaña de venta de servicios, dirigida a empresas y autónomos en España. El trabajo es completamente remoto y ofrecemos todas las herramientas y el apoyo necesario para el éxito. Responsabilidades principales: - Contactar proactivamente con empresas de nuestra base de datos. - Establecer comunicación con los dueños o responsables de negocio. - Identificar las necesidades de los clientes y presentar propuestas de servicios adecuadas. - Resolver dudas, gestionar objeciones y cerrar acuerdos de contratación. - Registrar detalladamente las llamadas y realizar seguimientos en el CRM. Facilitamos: - Acceso a una base de datos de empresas españolas. - CRM y sistema de llamadas integrado. - Guiones de venta y un proceso de venta estructurado. - Formación completa sobre nuestros servicios. - Material de apoyo y acompañamiento constante del equipo. Requisitos del perfil: - Mínimo dos años de experiencia comprobable en ventas telefónicas, en cualquier sector. - Dominio del español neutro, con pronunciación clara y excelente dicción. - Experiencia previa en ventas a empresas (B2B) es altamente valorada. - Habilidad para adaptar la conversación a las necesidades de cada cliente y cerrar ventas de manera efectiva. - Gran capacidad de constancia, organización y una fuerte orientación a objetivos. - Contar con ordenador, auriculares y una conexión a internet estable. Horario de trabajo: De lunes a viernes, de 9:00 a 14:00, hora peninsular de España. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Televentas Tiempo requerido: Más de 20 horas
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante: Juan M. B. (España). Publicó el anuncio en Workana (Ayer) con presupuesto de Menos de USD 15 / hora.

opportunities.title: Atención WhatsApp para Clientes
opportunities.description: Necesito apoyo diario para responder consultas de clientes que llegan por WhatsApp acerca de nuestros productos y servicios. El foco principal es aclarar dudas y brindar, en cada mensaje, información clara de precios y disponibilidad. Cómo trabajaremos: • Te compartiré nuestro catálogo/lista de precios actualizada; ahí encontrarás todo lo necesario para responder con precisión. • Mantendrás un tono cordial, profesional y coherente con la imagen de la marca. • Registrarás preguntas frecuentes o inquietudes recurrentes para que podamos mejorar la información del catálogo. • Avisarás de inmediato si algún precio o stock no coincide con lo que el cliente está solicitando. Busco a alguien organizado, con excelente redacción en español y experiencia previa en atención al cliente por mensajería instantánea (WhatsApp Business, Zendesk o herramientas similares). Si te interesa, coméntame tu experiencia y disponibilidad horaria.

Realizo **bioconstrucción en guadua, muro tendinoso con botellas y vidrio, todo tipo de cubiertas y estructuras en metal/soldadura, secaderos de café, murales artísticos, modelado 3D en Blender y planos**.

📲 Contacto directo en San Agustín, Huila (Colombia): **+57 322 273 9034**.

blueprint.product_type: 🤖 Bot de Respuesta y Agendamiento en WhatsApp 24/7 (Plantilla n8n / WhatsApp)
blueprint.deliverable: Flujo ya armado que responde precios, envía catálogo PDF/fotos y agenda citas en Google Calendar/Sheets.
blueprint.target_audience: Clínicas odontológicas, centros de estética, barberías, inmobiliarias y tiendas en Instagram Colombia.
blueprint.suggested_pricing: COP $350.000 por dejarlo instalado + COP $80.000/mes opcional por mantenimiento.
blueprint.distribution_channels: Contactar por WhatsApp o Instagram DM a negocios locales que dicen 'Citas por WhatsApp' en su biografía.
